governance_basis.role: gate definition GO / REVISE_LOCALIZER / NO_GO + prospective-freeze requirement
prospective gate freeze; no post-hoc numerical GO/NO-GO thresholds
evidence discipline; no fabricated metrics; no significance claim unless tested
Part-1D R1 protocol boundary; gate verdict FORBIDDEN in Part 1D

A.name: ORACLE_MECHANISM_VALUE
A.question: Does the Phase-12 oracle experiment continue to provide credible descriptive evidence that regional high-resolution processing has mechanistic value?
A.exception: only if Part1D-B reveals a material integrity or reproduction defect in the Phase-12 oracle evidence itself
evidence_basis_recorded_at_phase12: positive aggregate Dice across all four models
A.allowed_interpretation: carry the Phase-12 conclusion forward unless an integrity/reproduction defect is demonstrated
A.forbidden_posthoc_behavior: re-labelling A as unsupported merely because the GT-free localizer performs poorly

B.name: PRACTICAL_LOCALIZATION_RETENTION
B.question: Does the frozen GT-free predicted-region pipeline retain meaningful downstream segmentation utility relative to the global baseline and the Phase-12 oracle upper-bound/mechanism result?
B.allowed_interpretation: meaningful practical downstream utility means segmentation utility, NOT merely proposal/localization coverage
B.forbidden_posthoc_behavior: declaring B satisfied from proposal coverage alone; inventing a retention cutoff after seeing results

C.name: GLOBAL_PRESERVATION_FP_COST
C.question: Does predicted regional replacement preserve acceptable global segmentation behavior, or does it introduce broad adverse segmentation cost?
C.allowed_interpretation: descriptive comparison of benefit versus adverse cost; heterogeneity reported explicitly
C.forbidden_posthoc_behavior: declaring C acceptable by ignoring FP/precision cost; inventing an FP-increase allowance after seeing results

D.name: GENERALITY
D.question: Is the practical signal supported across the four frozen architectures rather than being an architecture-specific accident?
D.forbidden_posthoc_behavior: selecting a favourable architecture post hoc; declaring a winner; averaging heterogeneity away

GO.prospective_meaning: Oracle helps AND predicted localization retains meaningful practical utility.
required_evidence_pattern: B shows meaningful practical GT-free downstream utility rather than merely proposal coverage
C does not show broad systematic degradation that undermines the practical benefit
D shows the signal is not merely an isolated architecture-specific artifact
GO.action: Promote the regional mechanism toward RA-MedFiLM-Seg++.
notes: A GO conclusion does NOT require predicted performance to equal oracle.
Retention >1, <1 or negative values must be preserved honestly.

REVISE_LOCALIZER.prospective_meaning: Oracle helps BUT predicted localization loses too much practical benefit / global preservation cost is materially problematic; the regional hypothesis is not abandoned, but the deployable localization/fusion path requires revision.
required_evidence_pattern: at least one of: B is weak, inconsistent, or fails to translate the oracle mechanism into sufficient deployable segmentation utility; C shows material preservation / FP-cost problems; D indicates the effect is too architecture-specific
REVISE_LOCALIZER.action: Do not abandon the hypothesis; redesign localizer work first. Do NOT automatically redesign the localizer in Part 1E.
REVISE_LOCALIZER.critical_rule: A poor GT-free localizer result MUST NOT be relabelled NO_GO while A remains supported.

NO_GO.prospective_meaning: Even oracle evidence is insufficient / invalidated; do not force regional complexity.
required_evidence_pattern: A is no longer scientifically supportable
e.g. the Phase-12 oracle mechanism evidence is invalidated by a material integrity/reproduction problem, or no longer demonstrates meaningful regional mechanism value
NO_GO.action: Do not force regional complexity; proceed with global multi-domain MedFiLM and document the negative evidence.
NO_GO.critical_rule: A poor GT-free localizer result alone MUST NOT produce NO_GO while A remains supported.

CHECK_REQUIRED.prospective_meaning: An integrity precondition failed; scientific integrity takes precedence over gate classification.
required_evidence_pattern: at least one material unresolved integrity failure in Part1D-B

forbidden: no post-hoc subgroup invented for gate justification

forbidden_posthoc_behaviors: defining any new numerical gate threshold after seeing Part1D-B
constructing a model rank or declaring a winner
inventing a post-hoc subgroup to justify the gate
using the 16-case gallery to determine the gate
converting the gate into a statistical superiority or clinical superiority claim
relabelling a poor deployable result as NO_GO while dimension A remains supported
issuing any gate verdict while a material integrity failure is unresolved
